ce_bugs.text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:92 — Persisting guests before the calendar update leaves an unrepairable partial booking when that external call fails, because a retry rejects the now-existing guests.
packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts:5 — The unbounded guest array lets any authorized attendee create an arbitrarily large database/calendar/email fan-out in one request.
packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:170 — Swallowing every notification error returns success after invitations fail, leaving no retry or signal to the caller.

packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:158 — Calendar updates use the requesting user's credentials rather than the booking organizer's, so authorized non-organizers update the wrong account or fail.

packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:165 — A calendar failure occurs after attendees are committed and before emails, while retrying the same guests is rejected as already present.

packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:165 — A calendar-update failure occurs after attendees are committed, so the mutation fails while the booking retains guests that were never synced or notified.

mrv_findings.text: P2 confidence 75 — packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:100 — `attendees: { createMany: { data: guestsFullDetails } }` — the change only appends attendees with no way to view, remove, or otherwise manage existing guests, leaving the stated functionality incomplete.

P2 confidence 100 — packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts:5 — `guests: z.array(z.string().email()),` — direct API callers can submit duplicate addresses despite the UI uniqueness requirement, creating duplicate attendees or failing the whole update.

P2 confidence 100 — packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:168 — `await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests);` — a mixed request passes unfiltered addresses to notification selection, so an existing attendee receives a new-booking confirmation although not added.

P2 confidence 100 — packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:24 — `export const addGuestsHandler = async ({ ctx, input }: AddGuestsOptions) => {` — no test changes verify authorization, validation, persistence, calendar update, or notifications, leaving required behavior without regression evidence.

P1 confidence 100 — packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:92 — `const bookingAttendees = await prisma.booking.update({` — attendees commit before the calendar update, so an integration failure leaves guests claimed in the booking but absent from the calendar and unretriable.

P1 confidence 100 — packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:158 — `const credentials = await getUsersCredentials(ctx.user);` — permitted team admins and attendees update the organizer's calendar using their own credentials, targeting the wrong calendar or failing after the booking changed.

P1 confidence 100 — packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:74 — `const uniqueGuests = guests.filter(` — comparison only against the pre-update attendee snapshot permits duplicate concurrent, replayed, or same-request guest state.

P2 confidence 100 — packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:168 — `await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests);` — raw request addresses rather than `uniqueGuests` re-notify pre-existing attendees as newly added.

P2 confidence 100 — packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:167 — `try {` — notification failures are swallowed with only `console.log`, so success can silently diverge from notifications without retry or failure signal.

P2 confidence 75 — packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts:5 — `guests: z.array(z.string().email()),` — an unbounded guest count materializes attendees, translations, calendar recipients, and emails synchronously, allowing request-driven resource exhaustion.

P2 confidence 100 — packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts:5 — `guests: z.array(z.string().email()),` — no maximum guest count permits an authorized caller to use the endpoint for bulk-email spam and resource exhaustion.
